limitations: The exact probability statement is in the paper's random-oracle model; the concrete SHAKE256 runs do not prove success for every fixed message.
The attack is existential message search, not a universal or fixed-preselected-message forgery.
The claim covers standard SSD1760 only and excludes LVK, SSD2744, SSD3728, malformed keys, and rank-deficient Gen1 draws.
No concrete hash, message encoding, signature serialization, or author implementation was available.
The exact-target history result is a bounded public search and cannot exclude private, deleted, unpublished, or unindexed work.
